title: Closing Well Ceremony
idiom: linocut / woodblock print, warm ink tones
hero_prompt: A bold linocut print of a man seated alone at a round table lit by a single lantern at dusk, four small carved wooden tokens laid before him — one held up, one passed across the table, one pressed into the wood grain, one released into the shadow beyond the light.
icon_prompt: A bold linocut emblem of a single lantern with four thick radiating rays, one ray broken free and falling away, rendered in high-contrast black ink on cream.
